answers.q: I am 65 years old and coming for a general consultation. What is the fee?
answers.answer:
Sources: [1], [2]
The fee for a general consultation for a senior citizen (60 and above) is 450. Reception can stamp and sign a receipt for you to claim from your insurer if you need to use insurance.

answers.q: I saw the doctor four days ago and I am coming back about the same thing. What do I pay?
answers.answer:
Sources: [1], [2]
You pay the follow-up fee of 300 as you are coming back within 7 days for the same issue. The clinic does not bill insurance directly, so you will need to claim this fee from your insurer. Reception can stamp and sign a receipt for you to use for insurance purposes.
labels: Vaccinations and tests > What we do not do here

answers.q: I am 70 and coming for a follow-up three days after my consultation. What do I pay?
answers.answer:

You pay the follow-up fee of 300. Bring your appointment code and a photo ID. First-time patients should also bring any previous prescriptions and reports so the doctor can see your history.
